name: SystemBanner
description: A full-width system-level banner displayed at the top of the page for critical system messages, maintenance notices, or service degradation alerts. More prominent than Banner, intended for system-level concerns.

notes: Error and warning banners use role='alert' (assertive).
When onClose is provided, a dismiss button is rendered with an accessible label.
Action button is keyboard accessible with focus-visible styling.
Should be placed at the very top of the page above all other content.

variant.description: Semantic variant controlling color and urgency.

actionLabel.description: Text for an inline action button.

onAction.description: Callback fired when the action button is clicked.

onClose.description: When provided, a dismiss button is rendered.

do: Place at the very top of the page above all navigation.
Use 'error' for outages or critical system failures.
Use 'warning' for maintenance windows or degraded service.
dont: Do not use SystemBanner for form-level errors — use Alert or Notification.
Do not show multiple SystemBanners simultaneously.
Do not use for marketing announcements — use Banner instead.
